notes.title: Celebrate Couch Co-Op Fest with the Chaotic Party Night bundle!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi everyone, we hope you’re well?[/h3] 

We’re just checking in to celebrate [b]Steam’s Couch Co-Op Fest[/b] and the launch of a new bundle that seeks to capture the spirit of good old fashioned party game nights!  

For enjoyers of slapstick Japanese gameshows, high stakes octopus racing, and interspecies shopping trolley manoeuvring the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49700/Chaotic_party_night/][b]Chaotic Party Night bundle[/b][/url] includes [b]Nippon Marathon[/b], [b]Muddledash[/b] and [b]Supermarket Shriek[/b] plus a 15% discount when you ‘complete the set’.  

All three games will be on deep discount [b]until 17th February[/b] so now is the perfect time to grab your friends and indulge in some truly unhinged couch co-op and PVP madness!

[b]Nippon Marathon:[/b] A crazy, physics-driven, four-player marathon across Japan. Smash through offices and shopping malls and hurl fruit at your opponents in a party game unlike anything you've played before!

[previewyoutube=O8eyd-ooPcs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Muddledash:[/b] Join your friends on a mad race to the most bopping octopus party of the year. Slap your friends down with your tentacles to wrestle the present out of their hands, and make it to the finish line first. 

[previewyoutube=gYnbkY4Fjyw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Supermarket Shriek:[/b] Man meets goat in this award-winning couch-co-op adventure! Tackle outlandish courses, complete rewarding challenges and dodge deadly obstacles in a hectic race to the checkout! Packed with a frantic 38 stage campaign and 3 hilariously fun PvP party modes for up to 8 players.

[previewyoutube=POaKFrWGmI0;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy!

PQube and slampunks

notes.title: Cool off with the Steam Summer Sale – get up to 90% off PQube Games!
notes.notes:

Gal*Gun Returns

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425730/

Inertial Drift

Let off some steam (!) with this innovative twin-stick racing game, now at 33% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/

Cat Quest II

Cats or dogs? Single player or co-op? No need to pick- we’ve got both in this wildly popular action-RPG! Now at 45% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/914710/

Songbird Symphony

Guide orphaned chick ‘Birb’ through a beautifully crafted pixel world in this rhythm-action platformer: now 55% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/909820/

Die After Sunset

OK, this one isn’t in the sale, but we think you’ll love it all the same. Battle for Earth and travel through time this newly announced 3rd person action roguelite. But be careful! You never know what’s lurking in the shadows…

Wishlist now to be the first to get updates on Die After Sunset, coming soon to Steam Early Access.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440010/

notes.title: Muddledash joins the party on Steam TODAY!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32970945/d48061880c87ad92c44ac9c4fbb4427a35f3623a.png[/img]

PQube and Slampunks are incredibly happy to announce that the ultimate competitive party game Muddledash is out TODAY on Steam!

The game is available to purchase right now on Steam at the price of £4.79/€4.99/$5.99! Steam users can grab a 10% saving on their Muddledash purchase for the entirety of launch week, so don’t miss out!

Steam users can also immerse themselves in even more Muddledash party fun with the Muddledash Official Soundtrack containing a whopping 39 tracks! For the entirety of launch week, you can also save 15% on the soundtrack purchase.

Finally, if you're one for even more savings you can pick up the Muddledash + Soundtrack Bundle and save yourself a massive 21%!

We're incredibly proud and thankful to everyone that supported us throughout the greenlight phase to the many events we attended right through to our very own official release date today.

notes.title: Muddledash wins Best Multiplayer Game at Brazil's Independent Games Festival
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32970945/18077a770e25263dafdcaaf9ebbaf3988386b002.png[/img]

Grand news! We've been awarded the "Best Multiplayer Game" for Muddledash at BIG Festival in São Paulo! 🦑🏆

We were up against some fantastic competition -- it's a real surprise to win, and we're thrilled it's been received so well.

All through development, we've been in the habit of submitting to events here and there. It's been incredibly humbling to have the game picked in the first place, and to see people giving it a go. 
It's also been great motivation for us to keep tweaking things to get the best out of Muddledash. If you've ever chatted to us at an event, your comments have probably affected the final thing!

And so: After countless tweaks over the past couple of years, we're really happy with what Muddledash has turned out to be. We hope you are too -- [b]only 10 days to go![/b] 💖

notes.title: Coming July 10th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32970945/da329d668fe067143b02228ce1a244ed88924519.jpg[/img]

Hello all,

July 10th is just around the corner which brings us to the official launch date for Muddledash!

Launch week will feature a 10% discount across the board for Muddledash, so don't forget to add the game to your wishlist if you're interested so you don't miss out on the promotion!

Prepare to experience the most glorious competition the world has ever seen: one shiny present, up to 4 scrambling podes, a selection of sweet hats and a relentless race for the right to party!

You can’t possibly show up to the party without bearing gifts, that’d be rude, but with only one present among you, someone’s about to be out of luck! Don your best party hat and speed across an endless variety of levels, as you battle for possession of the present and race against your friends in a mad scramble to be the first to the party bearing gifts.

Join the hectic brawling race to be first with the present in this fun-filled couch-based party game!
